subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a shared group-level pending approval contract now, with unapproved group content excluded from agent sessions by default?
rationale: Implementation requires a durable cross-channel authorization model and a deliberate security decision about whether content from an unapproved group may be processed or retained.

options.title: Approval Only
options.body: Add owner notification and explicit group approve/reject state while dropping every unapproved group message before agent execution.

options.title: Broader Access Requests
options.body: Sponsor the grouped access-request design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89569 and require it to cover group identity and approval without raw-content exposure by default.

options.title: Channel Controls Only
options.body: Keep shared policy unchanged and pursue channel-specific notify, warn, or leave behavior without a group-pairing state machine.

recommendation.title: Approval Only
recommendation.body: Add owner notification and explicit group approve/reject state while dropping every unapproved group message before agent execution.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared group-policy decision path and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether and how it expands.
